blocked.resolution: [DOCUMENTED, third-party integrations verified against Forminator 1.57.3] A form is a `forminator_forms` post; its fields and settings are the post meta `forminator_form_meta`. Neither is exposed over REST. wix-wp-plugin-v2 reads the post rows from `posts`, filtered to this post type (a shared core table needs the filter).

pitfalls.summary: [DOCUMENTED] The post row carries only the form's title and status. Its fields (each with a stable `element_id` such as `name-1`, `email-1`), conditional logic and email settings are one PHP-serialized array in post meta `forminator_form_meta`. Add it to this entity's read plan as a key-scoped child component (`postmeta`, `eav-pivot-v1`, foreign key `post_id`, keys `{ "forminator_form_meta": "scalar" }`, required) per PLUGIN-READ-PLANS.md. Pin exactly that key: never run key discovery over the whole `postmeta` table for this entity. The form's display name is `settings.formName` inside the meta, falling back to the post title. Unserialize it in code, never by pattern matching.

Recreated forms keep their fields, not their notification emails or conditional logic: Wix Forms has no import surface for either. The forms import hands each one to cutover as an item the operator can resolve or dismiss.
[DOCUMENTED] Forminator quizzes (`forminator_quizzes`) and polls (`forminator_polls`) are separate post types and are not forms. This entity reads `forminator_forms` only.

blocked.resolution: [DOCUMENTED, third-party integrations verified against Forminator 1.57.3] Entries live in Forminator's own table `frmt_form_entry` (one row per entry), with each answer in `frmt_form_entry_meta`. No REST route exposes them. wix-wp-plugin-v2 reads the entry rows; the sample keeps form entries only (the table also holds quiz and poll entries).

pitfalls.summary: [DOCUMENTED] The entry row has no answers. Each answer is a row of `frmt_form_entry_meta` (`entry_id`, `meta_key` = the form field's `element_id`, `meta_value`; complex answers such as name parts, checkboxes and uploads are PHP-serialized arrays). Add it to this entity's read plan as a child component (`eav-pivot-v1`, foreign key `entry_id`, keys from key discovery over that table, `required: false`) per PLUGIN-READ-PLANS.md. Keys starting with `_` or `forminator_addon_` are Forminator's own bookkeeping, not answers. An upload answer's leaves include the server's file path; map only its `file_url`.

[DOCUMENTED] `is_spam` arrives as the string "0" or "1" (every bridge value is a string): compare with `=== '1'`, never a truthiness test, or every entry reads as spam. Entries with `is_spam === '1'` are not imported. They are the census sub-part `entity:plugin.forminator.entry/spam`: the operator approves that exclusion at the mapping review, and the importer reports it as an `exclusions[]` row (`reasonCode: source-flagged-spam`, the counted `censusId`), never a silent skip.

Every form's entries share one table, keyed by `form_id`. Filter the source rows to the form being imported AND resolve that same form's crosswalked target form id; assert the pairing before the first write (rp-source-wordpress SKILL.md, 'A submissions table shared by every form').

[DOCUMENTED] Newer Forminator versions add a `status` column (`active`, `pending` for an unpaid Stripe checkout, `spam`, drafts and abandoned entries); older rows and versions have none. It is not in the sample request, because naming a missing column fails the whole read. Check the live `/structure` columns before using it, and treat a missing status as `active`.
[DOCUMENTED] `date_created` is stored in the site's local time with no zone. Convert with the source site's time zone (source-locale.json) before writing it anywhere as an instant.

quirks: [DOCUMENTED] Facts in this profile come from Forminator's documented storage, as used by third-party integrations verified against Forminator 1.57.3. None was read from a live Forminator site yet; confirm the table columns with the bridge `/structure` route on the first run and update this profile.

This profile claims both `content.form-definitions` (forms/form) and `content.form-submissions` (forms/form-submission). Old entries default to native Wix Forms entries; a private CMS archive is the operator's override, never a profile ref.
